question: Should nullable `plugin.approval.resolved` events be the supported cancellation contract for all plugin approval consumers before this PR lands?
rationale: The PR adds a gateway method and widens an exported plugin SDK event shape, which repository policy treats as compatibility-sensitive plugin API/protocol surface.

options.title: Require one nullable cancel contract
options.body: Land only after every abort-aware plugin approval waiter uses the cancel path and SDK/channel tests cover the nullable resolved event.

options.title: Keep cancellation internal for now
options.body: Avoid widening the public resolved-event contract until maintainers approve a permanent cancellation API shape.

options.title: Accept a narrow partial fix
options.body: Land only the before_tool_call cleanup and keep #98576 or a follow-up open for Codex/native relay stale approvals.

recommendation.title: Require one nullable cancel contract
recommendation.body: Land only after every abort-aware plugin approval waiter uses the cancel path and SDK/channel tests cover the nullable resolved event.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged and hardened the original plugin approval contract and routing behavior.
